author: stmycraft
body:
Sadly to say, I have been banned and I tried to purge my name of any bans that I could. I have a few questions to ask
-Can you post on the forums if you've been banned
-can you go onto IRC chat or Discord or whatever if you've been banned
-If you're permanently banned from the server, like I mean permanently PERMANENTLY banned, are you still allowed to use the forums to chat?
thank you for answering or reading.

replies.author: Goodnighht
replies.body:
Can you post on the forums if you've been banned\

can you go onto IRC chat or Discord or whatever if you've been banned

If you're permanently banned from the server, like I mean permanently PERMANENTLY banned, are you still allowed to use the forums to chat?

Yes, you can. If you have access to it, you can use it. (within the rules of course)

Hope this helped. :)
